purpose: Remove baked interface text, captions, progress lines and frame; render native kiosk UI over clean photographic backgrounds.

prompts.01:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: clean full-bleed photographic background for an interactive heritage kiosk. Edit the supplied 1672x941 UI screenshot into a clean photo by removing ALL overlaid interface graphics and captions: the upper-left site name, upper-right History/Space links, vertical Explore label and lines, the large 01/02/03 story index, left title/paragraph/CTA, all three bottom navigation labels and numbers, all progress lines, the entire bottom caption row including index and italic caption, the down-arrow circle, and the rounded black outer frame. Reconstruct only the covered photographic background. Preserve the original real scene, architecture, camera perspective, statue/objects/trees, overall photographic color and lighting. Keep actual physical text attached to buildings, gates, signs, murals and objects; only remove graphic UI text. No new objects, signage or decorations. Return a full rectangular landscape photo without UI, without any black letterbox, without a border. No added text or controls.
Scene invariant: the white memorial temple with red roof and red flags, palms, potted plants and courtyard must stay in exactly the same composition.
